verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents project-level Brewfiles and a manually invoked `brew bundle exec` shell environment. There is no evidence that it activates tool versions or environment variables automatically when you enter a project directory. Community reports say users rely on pyenv, nvm or mise for per-project versions, so the closest feature is an adjacent manual command rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the right tool versions and environment variables activate automatically when I enter a project directory
